== Strategy ==

Start out by pulling Emperor and DS2 Docking Bay. Everyone will think that this is a regular BHBM deck but then u lay it on. When they have a character down at a site, deploy Lord Vader and all the Stormtroopers (Stormtroopers are Free!!!!!!!!!!!!)in your hand. Initiate a battle and use trooper assult and then Dark Jedi Presence. Each stormtrooper now has 6 power and it deployed for free! Since I have There is no try/Oppressive Enforcement sense should give u no problem. If you don’t beat your opponent here, drain and use Search and Destroy till they loose.The only deck you should have problems with is Hidden Base. If they don't deploy a character Deploy Vader to Endor DB and they lose 3 force every turn for your objective and 1 for Search and Destroy, Plus 1 for drains, a total of 5 force per round. I've tried this deck out and had 66 power on the first turn the oppnent had at least one character down at a battleground site, it was the second turn in the game.
